description: Before paying an x402 seller you do not know: settlement history, payer structure, funding links, endpoint liveness, quote-vs-advertised price. Use when one named provider or payment address is already in hand and you need a verdict before you pay it. PROCEED/CAUTION/REJECT/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with a signed receipt. PROCEED means no blocker or concern was found in what Ghost checked. Payability, transfer history, independent demand, seller identity and delivery are reported separately under `evidence`, with anything unresolved listed under `unresolved`; Ghost does not verify who the seller is or that it delivers. Paid per call via x402. Payment: $0.01 USDC on Base per call over x402, settled before the tool runs. An x402 MCP client such as x402-proxy pays it automatically; if you use x402-proxy, set its spend limits first (spendLimitPerTx 0.01, spendLimitDaily 0.10; see /llms.txt). A funded payment and delivery through x402-proxy has not been verified yet.
